'''MQ-12''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who served the [[Ministry of War (Sith Empire)|Ministry of War]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the ministry's [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] recruitment division.<ref name="TOR" />
